name: lu
title: LU Matrix Factorization
description: LU decomposition of a positive definite matrix as Gaussian factorization.
done: Doolittle LU in the kji, jki, and ijk orders, without pivoting.

name: lu_crout
title: LU Matrix Factorization
description: Crout LU factorization, with ones on the diagonal of U.
done: Crout factorization with ones on the diagonal of U.

name: lufact
title: LU Matrix Factorization
description: LU factorization with partial pivoting, plus the row permutation and determinant.
case: 3 by 3 pivoted LU, permutation, and determinant
done: Partial pivoting along rows, with the determinant sign.

name: lusys
title: LU Matrix Factorization
description: Solve a square linear system by LU factorization with row pivoting.
done: Pivoted LU followed by forward and back substitution.

name: givens
title: Givens Rotation
description: Givens rotations and QR decomposition.
done: Givens QR, returning Q transpose of the accumulated rotations.

name: gramSchmidt
title: Gram-Schmidt
description: Modified Gram-Schmidt process.
done: Modified Gram-Schmidt with the column 2-norm on the diagonal of R.

name: householder
title: Householder Reflections
description: Householder reflections and QR decomposition.
done: Householder QR with the sign taken from the pivot entry.

name: qrSolve
title: LSE Solution
description: Systems of linear equations via QR decomposition.
done: Householder QR, then back substitution.

name: null
title: Kernel or Nullspace
description: Alias of nullspace.
done: Alias of nullspace.

name: nullspace
title: Kernel or Nullspace
description: Kernel of the linear map defined by matrix M.
done: LINPACK column-cycled QR of the transpose, then the free columns of Q.

name: Rank
title: Matrix Rank
description: Provides an estimate of the rank of a matrix.
done: Singular values above the Matlab tolerance, with a warning when QR rank differs.

name: orth
title: Range Space
description: Range space or image of a matrix.
done: Leading left singular vectors above the Matlab tolerance.

name: subspace
title: Angle between two subspaces
description: Finds the angle between two subspaces.
done: Angle between orthonormal bases from the largest remaining singular value.

name: expm
title: Matrix Exponential
description: Computes the exponential of a matrix.
done: Trapezoid Cauchy integral, then zapsmall.

name: logm
title: Matrix Exponential
description: Matrix logarithm through the eigenvalues.
done: Real part of V diag(log(eigenvalues)) V inverse.

name: rootm
title: Matrix Square and p-th Roots
description: Computes the matrix p-th root of a nonsingular real matrix.
case: square root of a 3 by 3 positive definite matrix
done: Roots of unity integral for the p-th root.

name: signm
title: Matrix Square and p-th Roots
description: Matrix sign from the inverse square root of A squared.
case: sign of a 3 by 3 positive definite matrix
done: A times the inverse square root of A squared.

name: sqrtm
title: Matrix Square and p-th Roots
description: Denman-Beavers square root of a nonsingular real matrix.
done: Denman-Beavers iteration, returning the root, its inverse, the step count, and the residual.

name: mldivide
title: Matlab backslash operator
description: Emulate the Matlab backslash operator.
done: Pseudoinverse of t(A) %*% A times t(A) %*% B when pinv is true.

name: mrdivide
title: Matlab backslash operator
description: Emulate the Matlab slash operator.
case: row vector divided by a 3 by 3 matrix
done: Transpose of mldivide on the transposed arguments.

name: inv
title: Matrix Inverse (Matlab Style)
description: Invert a numeric or complex matrix.
done: solve, with an infinite matrix when the factorization fails.

name: pinv
title: Pseudoinverse or Generalized Inverse
description: Computes the Moore-Penrose generalized inverse of a matrix.
done: SVD pseudoinverse with the pracma singular-value cutoff.

name: cond
title: Matrix Condition
description: Condition number of a matrix.
done: Ratio of the largest and smallest singular values.

name: rref
title: Reduced Row Echelon Form
description: Produces the reduced row echelon form of A.
done: Partial pivoting with the eps tolerance, then zeros below that tolerance.

name: eig
title: Eigenvalue Function (Matlab Style)
description: Eigenvalues of a matrix.
done: Eigenvalues in R's decreasing order for a symmetric matrix, and by decreasing modulus otherwise.

name: eigjacobi
title: Jacobi Eigenvalue Method
description: Jacobi's iteration method for eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
done: Classical Jacobi rotations on the largest off-diagonal entry.

name: hessenberg
title: Hessenberg Matrix
description: Generates the Hessenberg matrix for A.
done: Householder reduction to Hessenberg form and the accumulating P.

name: arnoldi
title: Arnoldi Iteration
description: Arnoldi iteration generates an orthonormal basis of the Krylov space and a Hessenberg matrix.
done: Arnoldi with H stored as zeros(m, n), matching the source dimensions.

name: charpoly
title: Characteristic Polynomial
description: Characteristic polynomial by the Faddeev-Leverrier method.
done: Faddeev-Leverrier coefficients, highest power first.

name: normest
title: Estimated Matrix Norm
description: Estimate the 2-norm of a matrix by the power method.
done: Power iteration started from the column sums.

name: fnorm
title: Function Norm
description: The p-norm of the difference of two functions on an interval.
usage: fnorm(f, g, x1, x2, p = 2, npoints = 100)
done: Sample the two functions and take the vector p-norm of the difference.
py: fnorm(lambda x: np.asarray(x)**2, lambda x: 0*np.asarray(x), 0, 1, npoints=5)

name: nearest_spd
title: Nearest Symmetric Positive-definite Matrix
description: Find the nearest symmetric positive-definite matrix to A.
case: nearest SPD matrix to a 3 by 3 matrix
done: Symmetric polar factor, then a Cholesky repair that calls eps on the smallest eigenvalue.

name: isposdef
title: Positive Definiteness
description: Test for positive definiteness.
done: Cholesky test, with pivoted Cholesky when psd is true.

name: trisolve
title: Tridiagonal Linear System Solver
description: Solves a tridiagonal linear system.
done: Givens rotations on the subdiagonal, then back substitution.

name: itersolve
title: Iterative Methods
description: Iterative solutions of systems of linear equations.
usage: itersolve(A, b, x0 = NULL, nmax = 1000, tol = .Machine$double.eps^(0.5), method = c("Gauss-Seidel", "Jacobi", "Richardson"))
done: Gauss-Seidel, Jacobi, or Richardson, stopped on the relative residual.

name: gmres
title: Generalized Minimal Residual Method
description: GMRES attempts to solve the square system A x = b.
usage: gmres(A, b, x0 = rep(0, length(b)), errtol = 1e-6, kmax = length(b)+1, reorth = 1)
done: Arnoldi GMRES with Brown/Hindmarsh reorthogonalization.

name: hadamard
title: Hadamard Matrix
description: Generate a Hadamard matrix of a certain size.
done: Sylvester construction from order 2, 12, or 20.

name: Toeplitz
title: Toeplitz Matrix
description: Generate a Toeplitz matrix from a column and a row vector.
done: First column a and first row b, then shifted copies.

name: magic
title: Magic Square
description: Create a magic square.
done: Odd, doubly even, and singly even constructions.

name: hilb
title: Hilbert Matrix
description: Generate the Hilbert matrix of dimension n.
done: Entries 1 / (i + j - 1).

name: moler
title: Moler Matrix
description: Generate the Moler matrix of size n by n.
done: Lower triangle i - 2, then symmetrize and set the diagonal to 1:n.

name: rosser
title: Rosser Matrix
description: Generate the Rosser matrix.
case: leading 3 by 3 block of the Rosser matrix
done: The fixed 8 by 8 Rosser matrix.

name: vander
title: Vandermonde matrix
description: Generate a Vandermonde matrix from a numeric vector.
done: Columns are decreasing powers, ending at the constant 1.

name: wilkinson
title: wilkinson Matrix
description: Generate the Wilkinson matrix of size n by n.
done: Diagonal of absolute values from -(n-1)/2 to (n-1)/2, plus the off-diagonals of ones.

name: pascal
title: Pascal Triangle
description: Pascal triangle in matrix format.
done: Cumulative-sum Pascal matrix, with the signed and rotated variants for k 1 and 2.

name: hankel
title: Hankel Matrix
description: Generate a Hankel matrix from a column and a row vector.
done: Constant anti-diagonals, with the missing row filled by zeros.

name: blkdiag
title: Block Diagonal Matrix
description: Build a block diagonal matrix.
case: 2 by 2 block beside a 2 by 2 identity
done: Place each numeric matrix on the diagonal.

name: compan
title: Companion Matrix
description: Companion matrix of a real or complex polynomial vector.
done: Monic companion matrix after dropping leading zeros.

name: squareform
title: Format Distance Matrix (Matlab Style)
description: Format or generate a distance matrix.
done: Pack a strict lower triangle into a symmetric matrix, or the reverse.

name: tril
title: Triangular Matrices (Matlab Style)
description: Extract the lower triangular part of a matrix.
case: strict lower triangle of a 3 by 3 matrix
done: Keep entries on and below diagonal k.

name: triu
title: Triangular Matrices (Matlab Style)
description: Extract the upper triangular part of a matrix.
case: strict upper triangle of a 3 by 3 matrix
done: Keep entries on and above diagonal k.

name: deconv
title: Deconvolution
description: Deconvolution and polynomial division.
done: Polynomial division through convolution, returning quotient and remainder.

name: kron
title: Kronecker product (Matlab Style)
description: Kronecker tensor product of two matrices.
case: 2 by 2 Kronecker product with the identity
done: Kronecker product, including the R name kron.

name: randortho
title: Generate Random Orthonormal or Unitary Matrix
description: Generates a random orthonormal or unitary matrix of size n.
done: QR of a normal matrix with column signs taken from the diagonal of R. The check is the shape and a 1/0 orthonormality predicate.
py: (lambda q: np.array([q.shape[0], q.shape[1], float(np.max(np.abs(q.T @ q - np.eye(3))) < 1e-8)]))(randortho(3))
